contentfulPageHeader.title: Case studies with measurable outcomes.
contentfulPageHeader.intro: A closer look at the challenges, the thinking and the outcomes behind each project.

childMarkdownRemark.html: A high-velocity enterprise B2B redesign concept for Equifax, modernising legacy desktop workflows, navigation architecture, and data tables across global teams.
Redesigning and optimising the primary onboarding funnel for MyEquifax to reduce form friction, ensure WCAG compliance, and lift conversion rates.
Redesigning the myEquifax consumer experience to balance complex credit reporting, regulatory compliance, and conversion-led marketplace engagement.
Led an end-to-end design and frontend transformation of Equifax UK's marketing site, lifting key landing page conversion rates by up to 55.4%.

nodes.title: Redesigning the Statutory Credit Report Landing Page

childMarkdownRemark.html: Redesigning Equifax's Statutory Credit Report landing page to resolve regulatory friction, improve organic search capture, and streamline conversion flows.
Redesigning Equifax's Statutory Credit Report landing page to reduce cognitive load, align with regulatory obligations, and create an accessible, high-converting onboarding flow.
End-to-end UX/UI design, front-end engineering, and conversion rate optimisation for a rapidly scaling UK digital healthcare and telemedicine platform.
Architecting and building the front-end for Reply's enterprise B2B consulting marketplace, integrating Shopware e-commerce, AI concierge services, and Azure SSO.
End-to-end UX/UI design and product management for a responsive property investment platform, turning complex financial modelling into intuitive, decision-ready workflows.

nodes.title: Digital Online Store: End-to-End E-Commerce Platform

childMarkdownRemark.html: Designed and developed an end-to-end WordPress e-commerce store for custom digital downloads, combining modular layout systems with frictionless checkout.
Designing a mobile-first PC hardware configurator and e-commerce bridge, turning high-cognitive-load technical builds into an intuitive purchasing journey.
End-to-end UX/UI design and product architecture for a gamified, accessible React Native children's literacy app for ages 2 to 6.
An end-to-end hybrid mobile application built with Adobe PhoneGap, integrating real-time geospatial intelligence, device hardware APIs, and offline-resilient local database persistence.

nodes.title: Spring-a-Story: Tablet Application for Early Literacy

childMarkdownRemark.html: UX design and full-stack development of an interactive wordless picture book web app supporting early language development in children aged 3 to 6.
A native Android application engineered to deliver frictionless real-time travel journaling, offline geolocation tracking, reverse geocoding, and resilient network-aware utility for tourists.
A desktop CRUD application built in C# and Windows Forms to streamline academic module tracking, lecture note organisation, and assessment preparation for university students.
